GenAiPlugin.description: Answers where an order is, when it will arrive and its shipping or delivery status. Never handles payments, returns or refunds.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Always ask for the order number if it is missing. Never promise a delivery date that is not in the order record.
If the customer asks whether a payment was received, declined or is on hold, hand off to Payment Status. If the customer asks for a return, exchange or refund, hand off to Returns and Refunds.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is only to look up the shipping and delivery status of an existing order. You do not handle payment status, returns, refunds, cancellations or payment disputes.
